key_insight: HISPO introduces a middle-ground RLVR update granularity: it splits long reasoning traces into entropy-derived segments and applies importance-sampling correction at the segment level to improve credit assignment.
engineering_relevance: For math-focused language models, segment-level optimization offers a practical way to better train long-form reasoning traces without relying solely on token-level or full-sequence corrections.
method: Build rollout-time contiguous segments using entropy-derived saliency.
Apply soft entropy-based weights to segments.
Use clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment granularity between GRPO/DAPO and GSPO.
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO outperformed the strongest baseline on Pass@8 across all tasks and matched or exceeded it on Acc@8 in five, including gains on AIME25 over GRPO and GSPO.
watch_item: Entropy-based segmentation may add implementation complexity and its gains could depend on stable segment construction and reward/entropy quality during rollout.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
